newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian drug firm in spotlight on stock market.
newsitem.headline: Estonian drug firm in spotlight on stock market.

text.p: Estonian share trade was active on Wednesday, with the Tallinn Pharmaceuticals Factory in the spotlight, trading some 13 million kroons worth shares on the market's secondary list.
It was by far the most active stock and helped the secondary free market list outstrip the main Tallinn stock exchange official list in activity.
The free market registered trade of 15 million kroons, compared with nearly 10 million kroons on the official list. The Tallinn stock exchange index rose 0.23 percent to 96.65.
The Tallinn Pharmaceuticals volume was pumped up by a block trade of 300,000 shares, which changed hands at 45 kroons, compared with a closing price yesterday of 43.85 kroons.
Dealers said that some 10 percent of the company's share capital changed hands but they did not know who the buyer was.
On the main list, Forexbank led, closely followed by usual market leader Hansapank.

Forexbank traded 3.9 million kroons but its shares closed at 76.15 kroons versus 76.60 kroons. Hansapank had business of 3.8 million kroons and its shares continued to rise, reaching 95.50 kroons after 95.05 kroons.
Savings Bank had share trade of 1.3 million kroons and it eased to 36.70 kroons, 0.25 lower than yesterday.
"Investors are waiting for September's financial reports and the future of the market's activities will depend on these reports," said Savings Bank dealer Charlie Viikberg.
